order: Qualify immutable complete V source before the U parent commit is available, then reparent only after every final group passes. This overlaps independent validation without changing either source during its checks.
required_parent: Qualified circle replay increment U, not an unvalidated parent patch
qualification_gate: 18 groups on identical before/after source snapshots, final matrix188; source includes the frozen U implementation plus V changes.
reparent_gate: Import only the three U receipt files, reset only the isolated V branch/index, and prove every other source byte equals the qualified snapshot. Preserve both full qualification patch against S and V-only patch against U. All U implementation bytes are ancestral in the final V commit.
receipt_gate: Archive both source attributions and parent transition; validate new receipt text and complete evidence manifest. No non-receipt edit is allowed after qualification without rerunning affected checks.
push_gate: Full workflow and Clippy pre-push matrix still required on combined publication source.
